reason: The external_importers measure now also counts string-path dependents: files that name a path into an alias module in a string constant (for example a patch target such as 'orchestrator.landing_evidence._helper') and never import it, which break when task eta (5037) deletes the alias. This widens what is measured; nothing in the tree grew. Docstrings and bare module-name strings (logger names) stay uncounted.
